data.name: Rat's Resilience
data.description: A river rat is inured to dangers presented by disease-carrying parasites, poisonous fish, and other toxic river denizens. A river rat gains a +%1 bonus on saving throws against disease and poison effects.|min(6,RogueLVL/3)
